content.text: Digital creators often face restrictions in their ability to accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-how-one-creator|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-only-real-2|Why Payment]]s online, especially in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. This guide provides a robust solution using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-complete-infrastructure-15|supabase]] as your order database. By deploying either Stack 01 or Stack 02 from COREMERCH, you can set up a fully operational digital store that processes crypto payments seamlessly, ensuring you maintain complete control over your data and transactions. With deployment times as short as 4-6 hours for Stack 01, you can get started immediately.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment platforms often lock out creators in developing regions due to regulatory issues or lack of support. COREMERCH's infrastructure is built to bypass these limitations by leveraging components that are inherently accessible and free to use. By hosting on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, you eliminate dependency on conventional payment systems. This architecture enables creators to maintain ownership of their stores while facilitating automatic crypto payments through NOWPayments, ensuring smooth financial operations regardless of external market conditions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating your deployment, gather the necessary tools and accounts. You will need a GitHub account for Stack 01 or a Cloudflare account for Stack 02. Ensure you have created a Supabase project, as it will serve as your order database. Additionally, set up your NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which outlines the exact steps for deployment. Having the requisite accounts and materials ready will streamline your setup process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying your chosen stack. For Stack 01, upload your products to your GitHub Pages site, and configure Google Apps Script to handle backend logic. In Stack 02, utilize Cloudflare Workers to implement your backend while integrating Supabase for order management. Next, connect NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions, ensuring you choose low-fee networks like BSC or Solana. This setup not only allows for efficient payment processing but also automates the delivery of digital products to your customers.
Own your infrastructure; no dependencies on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it's time to test your setup. Start by processing a test transaction to verify that everything functions properly. Monitor the payment confirmation through NOWPayments to ensure that the webhook triggers as expected. Once you’ve confirmed the successful transaction, you can officially launch your digital store. Promote your offerings, driving traffic to your site and encouraging sales. The more you test, the more confident you will be in your store's performance.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital store, consider ways to expand your offerings. Utilize Supabase to manage additional products efficiently, ensuring that you can accommodate growing demand. Implement marketing strategies to promote your store and attract more clients. As your business scales, keep an eye on transaction volumes and system performance, adjusting your infrastructure as needed to maintain smooth operations. The modular nature of COREMERCH's stacks allows you to adapt and grow without significant reinvestment.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Deploy your store in hours, not weeks, with COREMERCH.

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up Supabase for my digital store?

To set up Supabase, create an account and initiate a new project. Define your database schema to manage orders and products. Use the Supabase client library in your backend to interact with the database during transactions.
Can I use Supabase with Stack 01?
No, Stack 01 utilizes Google Apps Script for backend logic. If you prefer using Supabase, opt for Stack 02, which integrates Cloudflare Workers and Supabase for a more robust order management system.
What types of payments can I accept through NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept various digital currencies without KYC requirements. This flexibility ensures that you can cater to a wide audience.
Is there any ongoing cost after deployment?
No, once you deploy your stack, you own everything without any ongoing subscription fees. You are responsible for hosting costs if applicable, but COREMERCH does not charge for continued access.
How do I promote my digital store once it's live?
Utilize social media marketing, create engaging content, and leverage SEO techniques to drive traffic to your store. Consider partnerships or collaborations with other creators to expand your reach.
Maintain complete control over your data and transactions.
